title: DEEP2 deep learning system detects elusive polyps in colonoscopy video
summary: DEEP2, trained on 3611 hours of colonoscopy video, was validated on 1393 hours from an unrelated source and reached 97.1% sensitivity at 4.6 false alarms per video; sensitivity was 88.5% and 84.9% for polyps visible under 5 and 2 seconds. It found an average 0.22 polyps per sequence missed by live endoscopists and offline annotators, and in a preliminary prospective study of 100 procedures it detected 0.89 additional polyps per procedure with no adverse events. The prospective study is small and false alarms are frequent.
ai_technology: DEEP2 deep learning real-time polyp detection system for colonoscopy video
organization: Hebrew University of Jerusalem; Shaare Zedek Medical Center; Bikur Cholim Hospital

evidence.unknown: Effect on adenoma detection and patient outcomes in larger trials; full text not reviewed.
